snippet.title: Splash Divers - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description:
Check out the Splash Divers trailer for this upcoming cozy exploration game. Splash Divers will be available on PC. 

In Splash Divers, dive freely without worrying about oxygen limits, countdowns, or combat as you explore colorful underwater environments and discover a variety of marine life. Use your camera to capture memorable moments and build your own ocean encyclopedia as you encounter everything from schools of tropical fish to playful and unpredictable sea creatures. Back on the island, collect shells and other treasures, meet fellow divers from around the world, and create a personalized diving journal with photos, stickers, and memories from your adventures.
